scope: Minimal output-gate counter CE cut; source audit and abstract protocol transition checks only.
exact_change: Remove gateGroupCnt reset from process8; reset to zero on accepted final process9 group, otherwise increment.

protocol_model.description: Paired old/new issue counters with ordered group collection; exhaustive reachable states for two consecutive tokens, arbitrary stalls, and hardware reset from every state. Intermediate arithmetic pipeline latency is abstracted by allowing any ordered collection after acceptance.

timing_intent: Counter CE depends solely on accepted process9. It can no longer share the process8 OR process9 token-load/shift CE merely through identical enable logic.
limits: No BSC, synthesis, RTL simulation, or placement/routing run for this change.
Abstract protocol checks are not RTL equivalence proof; combined functional and physical CI remains required.
